title: Task-Oriented Network Ranging via Joint Graph and Schedule Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.24702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Measuring inter-node distances is the basis for network localization, whereas acquiring node positions does not require a fully connected graph of distances. Existing complete-ranging protocols for network localization require every node pair to exchange signals, which prolongs the ranging cycle. In this paper, we propose sparse signal-multiplexing network ranging (S-SM-NR), a task-oriented framework that adapts the transmit-listen schedule to the ranging task required by network localization. First, we establish the S-SM-NR framework by formulating the joint design of the task graph and the transmit-listen schedule. Then, we analyze the minimum round count required by S-SM-NR and establish a connectivity condition for network localization. translated_title: 基于图与调度联合设计的面向任务网络测距
translated_abstract: 测量节点间距离是网络定位的基础，而获取节点位置并不需要完全连通的距离图。现有的用于网络定位的全测距协议要求每个节点对都交换信号，这延长了测距周期。本文提出了稀疏信号复用网络测距，这是一种面向任务的框架，可根据网络定位所需的测距任务自适应调整发射-监听调度。首先，我们通过联合设计任务图与发射-监听调度建立了S-SM-NR框架。然后，我们分析了S-SM-NR所需的最小轮数，并建立了网络定位的连通性条件。随后，我们开发了一种闭式联合设计，用以构建稀疏任务图和均衡的发射-监听调度。特别地，该联合设计能够实现最小轮数……
tldr: 本文提出面向任务的稀疏信号复用网络测距框架S-SM-NR，通过联合设计稀疏任务图与均衡的发射-监听调度，以最小轮数完成网络定位所需的测距任务，从而显著缩短测距周期。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes S-SM-NR, a task-oriented sparse signal-multiplexing network ranging framework that jointly designs a sparse task graph and a balanced transmit-listen schedule, enabling localization-required ranging within the minimum number of rounds and thus significantly shortening the ranging cycle.
